Proposal · v1 · 2026.06.02

House Reset — 79 Min Challenge
🤍 Samsung Bespoke AI Combo

"79 minutes for the house. The rest is mine."
SAMSUNG · WD90F25AHT · Bespoke AI Combo 25kg + 18kg
01 · Creative Intent
Show the benefit, not the feature.
Samsung's existing Combo content tends to read as brand-made and feature-focused — polished demos that show off what the machine can do, but stop short of showing what the machine changes in someone's day. Seeding content has to do the opposite. It has to make the viewer feel the actual benefit — what their own Sunday morning could look like with this combo running in the background.
Don't sell the feature. Show the lived-in benefit that comes from it — clearly, intuitively, in a way the viewer can imagine for themselves.
This proposal borrows the proven "1-Hour House Reset" TikTok format (@brooke.correll, @jessbelllll, @cass.spinelli) and uses it to translate the Combo's core USPs into a single emotional beat: "79 minutes for the house. The rest is mine." The chores get done. The combo does its thing in the background. And the payoff isn't a clean spec sheet — it's an hour of free time, visible on screen.
02 · USPs Embedded in This Video
1
79 Min — Wash + Dry in One Cycle
A daily load goes from dirty to fully dry in 79 minutes. A single shirt: 39. No transfers.
2
One Machine, Not Two
The step where you drag wet laundry to a separate dryer? Gone. One drum, start to finish.
3
Flex Auto Dispense — 25 Loads in One Fill
Detergent and softener preload once, last 25 cycles. No measuring before every wash.
4
AI Auto-Detect — Cycle Picks Itself
The Combo reads load weight, fabric, soil — and picks the right cycle automatically. AI Energy mode can cut consumption up to 60%.
03 · Video Flow (6 Beats · ~60–75 sec)
1
OPEN — Calm living room + "LET'S RESET THE HOUSE IN 79 MINUTES!!!" title
A Sunday morning that finally has room to breathe. Bold all-caps + emoji line.
2
SETUP — Load · Auto Dispense · Tap Start (3 cuts)
USP-driven sequence. Detergent self-loads. App taps start. Challenge begins.
3
CHORES — Dishwasher · Sink · Counter · Vacuum · Trash (each its own quick cut)
Five independent chore cuts. Pure rhythm, no narration.
4
ALERT — DING + LCD "Normal" + door opens wide, dry linens inside
The surprise beat. Easier than expected.
5
SHAKE + WIDE — Snap a sheet in the air + wide shot of the tidy house
The proof. Bone dry, no transfer. The whole house, reset, in one frame.
6
RESULT — Afternoon sun + round daybed + book + "the rest is mine"
The real benefit. 79 minutes didn't save time — it gave it back.
